rows.en: "Flag 1B0 is not set. To run this private
event, set flag 1B0 and try again.
Otherwise, execution will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Yamato: "...That's... Ymir and Sisk."
Touya: "I wonder what they're doing."
Yamato: "It looks to me like they're practising
cooking."
Sisk: "Hm? Oh!"
Touya: "H-Hey."
Ymir: "W-What brings you here?"
Touya: "What are you doing?"
Sisk: "We're practising cooking, as you can see."
Yamato: "I see... Oh, what about this neatly peeled potato?"
Sisk: "That's the one I peeled."
Touya: "Then the one that's lost all trace of its original shape..."
Ymir: "That was me..."
Touya: "O-Oh."
Ymir: "I've always been bad at this sort of thing.
I must be clumsy."
Sisk: "No, not at all.
You have a natural knack for it, Ymir.
You just need practice!"
Ymir: "Y-You think so...?"
Sisk: "Absolutely. Even if peeling leaves less than a third
of the potato, even if you're more likely to cut your own finger,
and even if your seasoning needs work, it'll be fine!"
Touya: "I-Is it that bad?"
Ymir: "...Yes."
Sisk: "I don't agree with the idea that just because you're a girl,
you should naturally know how to cook. But I think the desire
to try cooking is important.
Especially when it's for someone you love... Ah, come to think of it,
I got my cook's qualification because I wanted His Highness
to taste my home cooking...
So! I know exactly how you feel, Ymir!
Leave it to me!
I'll make a proper cook out of you, I promise!"
Ymir: "N-No, I wasn't really going that far..."
Sisk: "No! Doing things halfway is the worst thing of all!
Now, let the intensive training begin!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Sisk: "All right, you two, you're in the way! Move along!
No outsiders allowed!"
Touya: "H-Hey..."
Ymir: "Sorry about this."
Yamato: "Well, good luuuck!"
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's unusual.
I wonder if someone's inside."
Touya: "Well, people do use it."
Yamato: "But it's always stopped whenever I see it.
And it's right on the floor I'm on."
Touya: "You're imagining it. You're imagining it. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
To protect those I love, my blade of justice strikes the enemy!
My crimson blood burns red! Such is the way a man must live!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaariooon!!
I have arrived! For justice... I would die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Heeey!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I went to all the trouble of waiting for you..."
Touya: "...You ought to get Gabon to take a look at you."
Fain: "What?! I'm the very picture of health!
I'm not so feeble that I'd fall ill!
Bwa ha ha ha ha!"
Yamato: "...It's serious."
Fain: "...So, how was it? I'm pretty confident
about this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It was pretty good.
It sounded like enka.
Fain: "Right? Especially the last part. Even I got chills
saying it!"
Yamato: "He's drunk on himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, keep at it."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... You could call it 'the song
of the Japanese heart,' I guess."
Fain: "The heart? So you mean a song that speaks
directly to the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! Then that means my introduction
is just as magnificent!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Bwa ha ha ha ha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, how come you're always
so single-minded?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my greatest wish!
And that justice also protects those dear to me!"
Touya: "Huh. Those dear to you, eh...?"
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, and for Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice is not so
fickle! Oh, what am I supposed to do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "We'd better keep our distance..."
Fain: "Come on, we're friends!
Tell me, who should I fight for?
I have vowed in my heart to love just one woman.
Yet I also have the noble and supreme
duty of protecting the princess. I can abandon neither loyalty nor love.
Ah... What a trial! Such is the fate of a knight!
Then I shall press onward! To battle my destiny!
No, wait. My master also said that to desire too much at once
is the same as losing it all.
Does that mean I must commit myself to just one?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And to choose between Ymir and Kasumi...
Grr... This is all because of those fiends from ≪Ze=Ode≫...
If it weren't for them, I would never have had
to suffer like thiiis...
Wait! Could this be a conspiracy of theirs?!
Grrrrrr... Damn them... How vile...
No, what a fearsome foe is ≪Ze=Ode≫!!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, will not be discouraged
by such a trifle! Hm? Does that mean
that to turn their plan against them, I must preserve my love for both women
and my loyalty to the princess,
all at the same time?
No, but then I'd be defying my master's teachings.
Aaaaah, what am I supposed to doooo?!!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has his troubles too."
Touya: "Well, he seems happy enough with the way he is.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
